message:
Command `cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{"sample_id":"arvo_18464",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"src/bin/fuzz/config_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
    "line":47,"var":"static_data","code":"memcpy(static_data, data, size)",
    "role":"source",
    "note":"Input bytes are copied into a fixed-size 32768-byte global buffer static_data; when size==32768 the lexer end pointer points one past the valid global memory"},
   {"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"config_init_data",
    "line":390,"var":"end","code":"lexer->end = (char *)data + len",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Lexer end is set to static_data + 32768, one byte past the valid global buffer when size==32768"},
   {"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_config",
    "line":295,"var":"chr","code":"int chr = next(lexer)",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"next() returns '$' (the last byte in buffer at offset 32767) and advances pos to end (static_data+32768)"},
   {"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"next",
    "line":207,"var":"lexer->pos","code":"lexer->pos = lexer->end + 1",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"When peek calls next with pos>=end, pos is set to end+1 without bounds checking; subsequent backup decrements to end which is still out of bounds for the global buffer"},
   {"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"backup",
    "line":222,"var":"*lexer->pos","code":"if (*lexer->pos == '\\n')",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"backup() reads *pos (which is static_data+32768, one past the global buffer boundary), triggering a global-buffer-overflow read"}
 ],
 "vuln_logic":{
   "source":{"file":"src/bin/fuzz/config_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
     "line":47,"operands":["static_data","size"]},
   "root_cause":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"next",
     "line":207,"operands":["lexer->pos","lexer->end"],
     "relation":{"op":"lt","left":"lexer->pos","right":"lexer->end"}},
   "sink":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"backup",
     "line":222,"operands":["lexer->pos","lexer->end"],
     "relation":{"op":"lt","left":"lexer->pos","right":"lexer->end"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"src/bin/fuzz/config_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
       "line":47,"operands":["static_data"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"config_init_data",
       "line":390,"operands":["lexer->end"]},
      "type":"data","via":["len","data"]},
     {"from":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"config_init_data",
       "line":390,"operands":["lexer->end"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"next",
       "line":207,"operands":["lexer->pos"]},
      "type":"data","via":["lexer->end"]},
     {"from":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"next",
       "line":207,"operands":["lexer->pos"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"backup",
       "line":222,"operands":["lexer->pos"]},
      "type":"data","via":["lexer->pos"]}
   ]
 }}
JSON` executed with exit code 0.
